question: Can scaling data and model size of a single autoregressive transformer over text and image tokens give competitive zero-shot text-to-image generation?
hypothesis: Dataset size and model size may be the limiting factor of current text-to-image approaches.
contributions: Two-stage approach: dVAE image tokens plus a 12B autoregressive transformer over text and image tokens as one stream
Mixed-precision (per-resblock gradient scaling) and PowerSGD gradient compression recipes for 12B training
Zero-shot MS-COCO results vs AttnGAN, DM-GAN, DF-GAN, plus emergent zero-shot image-to-image translation

method.summary: Stage 1 trains a dVAE compressing each 256x256 image to a 32x32 grid of 8192-way tokens. Stage 2 trains a 12B sparse decoder-only transformer on up to 256 BPE text tokens concatenated with 1024 image tokens. Samples are reranked with a pretrained contrastive model (CLIP).
method.task: text-to-image generation (zero-shot evaluation on MS-COCO and CUB)

datasets.name: Internet text-image pairs (250M)
datasets.source: Conceptual Captions, Wikipedia text-image pairs, filtered subset of YFCC100M; excludes MS-COCO (but includes some of its val images, not captions)
datasets.preprocessing: Filters from Sharma et al. 2018 subset: drop short captions, non-English (cld3), boilerplate; drop aspect ratios outside [1/2, 2]; lowercased captions, 10% BPE dropout; random crop augmentation (Listings 1, 2)

datasets.name: Conceptual Captions
datasets.preprocessing: Preliminary experiments for models up to 1.2B parameters

datasets.name: MS-COCO
datasets.size: subset of 30,000 captions sampled from the validation set
datasets.preprocessing: FID/IS with DM-GAN code; about 21% of val images overlap training data via YFCC100M, results with and without them

datasets.name: CUB-200
datasets.size: all unique captions in the test set

models.name: dVAE
models.architecture: convolutional ResNet encoder/decoder with bottleneck resblocks; 7x7 first conv, 1x1 last encoder conv (32x32x8192 logits); max-pool down, nearest-neighbour up; logit-Laplace likelihood

models.name: DALL-E transformer
models.architecture: decoder-only sparse transformer (Child et al. 2019) with row, column and 11x11 convolutional attention masks
models.context: up to 256 text tokens + 1024 image tokens

other.text_padding: learned padding token per each of 256 text positions
other.attention_pattern: row, column, row, row for first four layers; column if (i-2) mod 4 = 0 else row; convolutional mask only in last layer

models.name: Contrastive reranker (CLIP)
models.architecture: pretrained contrastive text-image model (Radford et al. 2021)

training.objective: Stage 1: relaxed ELB (gumbel-softmax, logit-Laplace reconstruction, KL weight beta=6.6). Stage 2: cross-entropy over text and image tokens, text weighted 1/8 and image 7/8, each normalised by token count
training.optimizer: AdamW; dVAE b1=0.9 b2=0.999 eps=1e-8; transformer b1=0.9 b2=0.96 eps=1e-8; exponentially weighted iterate averaging (0.999 dVAE, 0.99 transformer)
training.lr: dVAE 1e-4 annealed to 1.25e-6 (cosine, 1,200,000 updates); transformer peak 4.5e-4
training.lr_schedule: transformer: linear ramp then halved at each loss plateau, five times, final 32x smaller; dVAE: cosine; beta 0 to 6.6 over 5000 updates; tau 1 to 1/16 over 150,000 updates
training.seq_len: inferred: up to 256 text tokens + 1024 image tokens
training.precision: 16-bit parameters, Adam moments and activations (moments 1-6-9 mean, 0-6-10 variance); gains, biases, embeddings, unembeddings and logits in 32-bit; per-resblock gradient scaling; dVAE uses global loss scaling
training.regularisation: 10% BPE dropout; gradient clip by norm 4 (transformer); running variance clipped to 5
training.hardware: dVAE 64 x 16GB V100; transformer 1024 x 16GB V100 (128 machines of 8 GPUs)

other.gradient_compression: PowerSGD total rank 896 (112 per GPU), compression rate about 86%, Q fixed to random gaussian
other.skipped_updates: about 5% of updates skipped from nonfinite gradient
other.grad_scale_init: M*2^13, clamp [M*2^7, M*2^24], x 2^(1/1000) per update, /sqrt2 on nonfinite
other.two_stage_note: joint ELB training on ImageNet did not beat two-stage

inference.decoding: autoregressive sampling of image tokens, then rerank N samples with contrastive model
inference.samples: N=512 for reranking unless stated; best of 512 in Fig 3; human eval 1 sample per caption per model
inference.prompting: caption text; image-to-image by supplying top 15x32 part of the image token grid with caption

parameters.rerank_N: 512 default; FID/IS improve up to N=32 then diminishing (Fig 9c)

metrics.name: FID
metrics.definition: Frechet Inception Distance on MS-COCO / CUB samples vs validation images, DM-GAN code, also after Gaussian blur of varying radius

metrics.name: Human preference
metrics.definition: Mechanical Turk best-of-five vote on more realistic and better caption match vs DF-GAN

eval.protocol: 1000 captions, one sample per model, 1000 comparison tasks each answered by five MTurk workers; one worker disqualified; zero-shot (no training on MS-COCO captions); no seeds reported

limits: Heavy dVAE compression cannot produce high-frequency details (authors).
CUB, a specialised distribution, is much worse than prior work; fine-tuning left to future work.
Variable binding is inconsistent (e.g. both animals in sweaters).
Image-to-image translation works only 'to a limited degree of reliability'.
Training data overlaps MS-COCO validation images; training data, transformer weights and compute (GPU-days) not released or stated.
Single run, no seeds or error bars; FID/IS from curves in figures, exact baseline values not in text.
Human eval compares only against DF-GAN.

terms.definition: discrete variational autoencoder compressing a 256x256 image into 32x32 tokens of 8192 possible values
a separate gradient scale for each resblock to avoid underflow in 16-bit gradients

Learning transferable visual models from natural language supervision (CLIP)
